ardupilot.catalogErrorTip:
Couldn't reach upstream: {{error}}
Click to retry.
ardupilot.catalogTip: Frame list mirrors ArduPilot upstream `vehicleinfo.py`. Click to refresh.
ardupilot.crashSwitchFrame: Both stable and dev binaries crash on <mono>{{failedModel}}</mono> for this platform - looks like an upstream physics bug specific to that frame. Try <mono>{{suggestedModel}}</mono> instead; it's the safe-default frame for this vehicle and is well-tested across builds.
ardupilot.crashSwitchTrack: The <mono>{{failedTrack}}</mono> binary doesn't run <mono>{{model}}</mono> on this platform. The <mono>{{suggestedTrack}}</mono> track is rebuilt nightly and ships fixes that haven't landed yet - same SITL, just a newer build.
ardupilot.flightGearNotDetected: FlightGear not detected. Install it from flightgear.org, then pick the executable.
ardupilot.matchTerrainTip: Look up the real ground elevation (AMSL) at this lat/lng and use it as home altitude, so FlightGear's real terrain and SITL's flat ground agree (fixes the vehicle appearing to float or sink)
ardupilot.noOutput: No output yet. Start SITL to see process output.
ardupilot.noUpstreamDefaults: No upstream defaults - ArduDeck baseline only.
ardupilot.physicsEngineDesc: Built-in uses ArduPilot's model. ArduDeck engine adds heavy-lift realism (battery sag, thrust fade) from your custom frame.
ardupilot.pickOnMapTip: Pick the spawn point on a map (ground elevation is filled in automatically)
ardupilot.simSpeedTip: How fast the simulation runs vs. real time. 1x = real-time. Higher finishes flights quicker but uses more CPU - leave at 1x if unsure.
ardupilot.simWorldDesc: A 3D view of the connected vehicle: fly, run missions, place obstacles (as exclusion fences) and inject wind/failures live. Works with standard SITL, and shows richer dynamics when the ArduDeck physics engine is enabled above.
ardupilot.spawnPickerSubtitle: Click where the simulated vehicle should spawn. Ground elevation is looked up automatically.
ardupilot.startSimWorldTip: Start SITL, connect, and open the 3D world
ardupilot.swarmRunningHint: Swarm is running! Start the multi-vehicle engine from the connection screen to fly the whole fleet together.
ardupilot.viewFlightGearStartFirstTip: Start SITL first, then view it in FlightGear
ardupilot.viewFlightGearTip: Open FlightGear as a 3D view of the running SITL mission

customFrame.activeFooter: Active frame is loaded via SITL --model on next start. Stop & restart SITL to apply.
customFrame.discAutoHint: Auto: {{count}} motors × π × (Ø/2)². Type your prop size in inches and disc area fills in; edit disc area directly to override.
customFrame.empty: No custom frames yet. Create one from a template or import a JSON file.
customFrame.estimateTip: Guess the prop size from the frame diagonal + motor count (rough starting point)
customFrame.title: Custom Frame Physics
customFrame.toastMissing: Active custom frame is missing - cleared
customFrame.useTip: Use this frame for next launch
